topics.title: COP31 ends without main climate pact
topics.summary: Negotiators in Antalya failed to reach consensus on the summit’s central climate agreement after disagreements over fossil fuels, finance and carbon-capture language.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a big group can’t agree on the final version, is it better to leave with a partial win or keep negotiating until everyone can live with it?

topics.title: Red Cross warns on autonomous weapons
topics.summary: The International Committee of the Red Cross says governments are running short on time to set meaningful rules for autonomous weapons systems.
topics.discussionPrompt: What rule would you want written first when machines are allowed to make faster decisions than people can?

topics.title: South Korea education chief resigns
topics.summary: South Korea’s education minister resigned after an AI-cheating scandal around university entrance exams, renewing questions about technology and trust in testing.
topics.discussionPrompt: If every school test had to adapt to AI, would you prefer open-book questions, hands-on projects, or something completely new?

topics.title: Technology outages fuel questions
topics.summary: A run of disruptions affecting airlines, banks and major technology companies has fed public anxiety about whether failures are connected or simply overlapping.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a favorite app or service goes down, do you shrug and wait, investigate every rumor, or suddenly remember life before the internet?

topics.title: AI sell-off shakes Nasdaq
topics.summary: A sharp sell-off in AI-linked stocks erased the Nasdaq’s gains for the year, as investors reconsidered the scale and pace of spending on AI infrastructure.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a new technology gets lots of hype, what makes you decide it is genuinely useful instead of just having a big moment?

topics.title: UK-EU food deal draws business praise
topics.summary: British businesses welcomed a UK-EU food agreement, saying closer alignment could make trade easier for companies working across the two markets.
topics.discussionPrompt: What food from another place do you wish were easier to find nearby: a snack, a cheese, a fruit, or a whole meal?

topics.title: GTA VI dominates culture chatter
topics.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is generating a wave of reviews, guides and debate, becoming one of the biggest entertainment talking points of the season.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes a game feel like a real shared cultural event: the story, the music, the friends playing it, or the conversations afterward?

topics.title: Potatoes proposed for moon menus
topics.summary: Scientists say potatoes grown in simulated lunar soil could become a practical food source for a future moon base, adding a humble crop to space-planning conversations.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you were planning the first moon café, what comfort food would absolutely need a space-friendly version?

topics.title: England rugby earns landmark win
topics.summary: England’s strength in depth helped deliver a notable victory over New Zealand, a result celebrated as an important moment for the team.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes a sports win memorable to you: an underdog story, a perfect comeback, a tense finish, or seeing a team finally click?

topics.title: California rail theft case draws attention
topics.summary: Authorities are investigating a series of California train thefts described as a carefully organized haul worth millions of dollars.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which mystery is more fun to unpack: a clever puzzle with clues everywhere, a missing-object case, or an elaborate plan that almost worked?
